title: settings.set
description: host → server. The host changes one or more room settings. Only the fields present change. The server broadcasts settings.state. Changes to timers and vote rules apply from the next vote round; a round already open keeps the values in its vote.opened.

LangTag.description: BCP 47 language tag, lower-case primary subtag (e.g. "en", "ar", "pt-BR").

PilotSelect.description: How the next pilot is chosen (§9.4).

RoleAssignMode.description: How roles are assigned in the lobby (§3.3).

RoomA11y.description: Room-wide accessibility flags set by the host (§16). Phones apply each flag in addition to their own preferences.

slowTimers.description: Cognitive: every server-run vote and poll timer is multiplied by 1.5 (rounded up to a whole second). Default false.

relaxedMinigames.description: Motor: every phone runs minigames in Relaxed mode. Default false.

reducedMotion.description: Motion: reduced-motion on every device. Default false.

highContrast.description: Visual: high contrast on every device. Default false.

subtitles.description: Hearing: phones show subtitles for voice lines and callouts. Default true.

explainTooltips.description: Cognitive: "Explain like I'm new" tooltips on every device. Default false.

SettingsPatch.description: Partial host settings: only the listed fields change. `a11y`, when present, replaces all six flags.

roleAssignMode.description: Role assignment mode (§3.3). Default RANDOM. Lobby-only.

voteTimerS.description: Duration of the VOTE stage of PART and CHOICE votes, seconds (§4.1 step 5). Default 20.

inspectTimerS.description: Duration of the INSPECT stage, seconds (§4.1 step 2). Default 20.

tallyVisibility.description: Live tallies open or hidden (§4.1 step 5). Default OPEN.

strictMajority.description: Strict-majority runoff on or off (§4.2). Default false.

assistLevel.description: Difficulty / assist level (§9.3). Default ENGINEER. Lobby-only.

audienceVoteWeight.description: Audience vote weight (§13.7): 0 = advisory only (default), 1 = the audience counts as one extra player ballot (judging-day mode).

pilotSelect.description: How the next pilot is chosen (§9.4). Default ROTATION.

passTheControls.description: Phones may act as virtual gamepads (§9.4). Default false.

lang.description: Language of the host screen. Default "en".

TallyVisibility.description: Whether live vote tallies are shown before the result (§4.1 step 5).
